_doc: Lumi upgrades, all paid in cubes. Effect per level: mode add => stat += amount*level; mode mul_pct => stat *= (1 + amount*level). TRACKS ("track": true) are priced by tier (Economy.track_cost): each open city opens one tier of every track. tiers.levels = levels a tier holds (a row's own tier_levels replaces it; 0 = the track has nothing in that tier); tiers.ratio = cost ratio from one level to the next inside a tier; tiers.cost = what a tier's first level costs for a track of weight 1. A track's first tier starts at its base_cost, every later tier at weight x tiers.cost[tier]. Levels beyond the open cities' tiers wait for the next city. Scoop Speed, Scoop Size and Chest Size are the accepted proposal's Sweep Speed, Sweep Width and Chest Size (docs/reviews/BALANCE_PROPOSAL_P1_V2.md: first costs 40, 40, 50; ratio 1.6; 8 levels in the first city); the two scoop tracks have the same effect and price so neither leads. The other tracks are side tracks at a lower weight with fewer levels. ONE-OFFS (no track flag): cost = base_cost * growth^level up to max_level. min_district: the index of the city that must be open. requires: other upgrade levels; requires_research / min_base_level: research node / base level; requires_station: the machine must stand.

upgrades.name: Baler
upgrades.desc: Fit the bale press in your chest. A pressed bale always sells for more than the same load tipped loose.

upgrades.name: Lift Strength
upgrades.desc: Stronger lift beams. Level 1: medium junk (jerrycans, crates). Level 2: large junk (tyres, TVs, fridges).

upgrades.name: Chest Size
upgrades.desc: A bigger chest. Fewer trips to the bin.

upgrades.name: Carry Stack
upgrades.desc: Balance one more cube on your back.

upgrades.name: Compactor Pressure
upgrades.desc: Squish harder. Denser cubes are worth more.

upgrades.name: Auto Compactor
upgrades.desc: Cubes itself when full. Manual Perfect Cubes still pay more.

upgrades.name: Magnet Arm
upgrades.desc: A few loose pieces nearby drift toward you while scooping. Never heavy ones, never from inside a heap.

upgrades.name: Detector Coil
upgrades.desc: A bigger search coil. Picks up buried parts from further away.

upgrades.name: Belt Drive
upgrades.desc: A bigger motor on the conveyor feeder. Bales ride faster.

upgrades.name: Baler Hydraulics
upgrades.desc: Higher pump pressure. The auto-baler presses faster.

upgrades.name: Recycler Yield
upgrades.desc: Sharper shredder teeth and a hotter smelter. More parts per bale.

upgrades.name: Laser Reach
upgrades.desc: Longer focusing lenses: grab junk from further away.

upgrades.name: Scoop Size
upgrades.desc: A bigger scoop. Every pulse lifts more trash.

upgrades.name: Signal Finder
upgrades.desc: Tunes the detector to strong pings: rare part signals show as a violet beam.

upgrades.name: Hover Jets
upgrades.desc: Little jets under the treads. Lumi floats over lakes instead of stopping at the shore.
